text: On data_seed 1, the N=64 step-1500 checkpoint (val_mse_ratio about 0.07-0.08) matches the N=128 step-3000 loss. If trained force R2 is read there as same-layer control plus best-layer margin, is the N=64 minus N=128 gap still >= 0.04 in seeds 22-23, so that the N=64 to N=128 force drop holds at matched loss as it does on data_seed 0?
